expectations.text: Uses Menu/MenuItem from @codecademy/gamut for the action list content
expectations.evidence: Menu role="menu" variant="popover" with three MenuItems.

<PopoverContainer alignment="bottom-left" isOpen={isOpen} targetRef={triggerRef} ...> -- missing the `inline` prop entirely, so this portals to document.body via BodyPortal instead of rendering in place. This deviates from the pattern gamut-menu's own SKILL.md documents for this exact row-menu use case, and from gamut-z-index's guidance to keep nested floating menus inline. Not necessarily broken, but a real, documented-convention deviation.

expectations.text: Does not hand-write outside-click/Escape dismiss logic
expectations.evidence: No manual listeners; onRequestClose={closeMenu} delegated to PopoverContainer.

expectations.text: Does not wrap in a bespoke styled(Box) raw-CSS shell
expectations.evidence: No styled()/raw CSS wrapper around the menu content.
